text:
olivia: Heads up — seeing a spike in remote_write 5xxs from the egress proxy in ap-sg around 08:10 UTC. Grafana alert fired: remote_write_errors > 2% for 5m.

 dan: I see it, p95 write latency jumped too. Any recent deploys to the proxy?

 olivia: No deploys on proxy. There was a scaling event for gpu-pool-us-east earlier but unrelated region. Logs show a lot of TLS handshake timeouts: `EOF` from upstream.

 karen: Can you paste the proxy error lines? Also which tenant/tenant-shard is noisy?

 olivia: Paste below:
```
2024-05-04T08:10:11Z proxy[proxy-1] WARN upstream write failed: Post "https://remote-write.cluster:443/api/v1/write": EOF
2024-05-04T08:10:11Z proxy[proxy-1] WARN retrying batch id=98765 backoff=200ms
2024-05-04T08:10:12Z proxy[proxy-1] WARN batch id=98765 duplicated after replay
```

 olivia: The duplicates line is interesting — looks like kvcache replay + proxy retry produced duplicate pushes that spiked cardinality.

 dan: Ah — we recently toggled `replay_on_resume: true` in the sidecar relabeler to reduce dropped series during short disconnects. Could be interacting badly with proxy retries.

 karen: Can we confirm which relabel configs are producing many unique series? Any label expansion at scrape time?

 olivia: Quick query: `count(count_over_time({job="gpu_exporter"}[5m])) by (instance, exporter_version)` shows a small set of instances with huge growth. Looks like exporter_version label being added by relabeler when exporter restarts.

 sre-oncall: Re-routed a subset of traffic to fallback remote_write endpoint (us-west mirror) at 08:15 UTC to mitigate errors. Error rate dropped but p95 latency still elevated.

 dan: Can we temporarily disable replay_on_resume on the sidecars in ap-sg? That should stop duplicate batches while we root-cause the TLS flakiness.

 karen: +1 — patch incoming. Will set `replay_on_resume: false` in the relabeler config for ap-sg sidecar DaemonSet and restart one node to validate.

 olivia: After disabling replay, errors dropped to baseline in 10m, p95 latency improved. Still seeing occasional `TLS handshake timeout` from the proxy; might be upstream natgw ephemeral port exhaustion during the QPS spike.

 dan: Let's correlate with NATGW metrics. Query: `sum(rate(natgw_conn_alloc_failures[5m])) by (az)` — any spikes?

 olivia: natgw_conn_alloc_failures spiked in ap-sg-1 at the same time. Looks like connection churn + duplicate sends caused port exhaustion.

 sre-oncall: For short term: leave replay disabled, increase proxy upstream connection pool and add splay on sidecar retry backoff. For medium term: add per-tenant write dedupe at the proxy (idempotency id on batch) and tune relabeler to avoid adding volatile labels like `exporter_version` when it changes frequently.

 karen: Filed an infra ticket for NAT gateway capacity increase for ap-sg and added a follow-up to add idempotency header on remote_write batches: INFRA-6342.

 dan: Also proposing alert rule change: split remote_write_errors by `reason` label and add a separate threshold for `duplicate_write` vs `upstream_5xx` so we don't trigger escalations for transient replay behavior.

 olivia: Good call. I'll update dashboards: add a panel for `duplicate_batches_total` and a table of top label keys causing cardinality bursts.

 sre-oncall: Closing the incident for now — root cause: sidecar replay + proxy retry + NATGW ephemeral port exhaustion -> duplicate batches -> cardinality spike. Remediation: disable replay, tweak backoff, increase natgw capacity, plan idempotency.

 prometheus-bot: Alert resolved: remote_write_errors returned to 0.6% (below threshold) at 08:25 UTC.

 olivia: Postmortem TODO: short writeup with timeline, config diffs, and the Grafana panels added. Assigning to karen + dan.

 karen: Ack. I'll include config snippets and the relabel regex that caused exporter_version injection.

 dan: Thanks team.
